title: Clouds
description: A living sky of clouds that form, drift and dissolve. Choose a cloud type — puffy fair-weather cumulus, a flat featureless grey stratus overcast, high fibrous cirrus mare's-tails, a towering storm, or one of the rarer types: smooth stacked lenticular lenses, pouchy mammatus hanging beneath a storm, a mackerel sky of regular dappled rows, or electric-blue noctilucent wisps — or let it slowly evolve between them. Turn the cover right up and the sky closes over into a dense overcast. Sunlight rakes across so cloud tops glow and undersides fall into shadow, and the whole field breathes as it moves on the wind. Type, cover, wind, evolution, sun angle and sky colour are live and mappable.
